instagram.author: drelishagoldstein
instagram.body:
We've spent so much time trying to change our reactions, but two decades in a therapy room has shown me over and over again that emotional maturity doesn't show up when you stop getting triggered. It shows up the moment you notice you're triggered.

And emotional strength isn't measured by how calm you stay. It's measured by how quickly you find your way back.

There's a question I come back to a lot when I feel the activation in my body and this is the tiny shift you can make here...

The next time you feel tense, ask yourself, "What part of me is still bracing?"

When you do that, something in the body softens, and when the body softens, the recovery gets shorter. The loop doesn't run as long, and you come back to yourself sooner.

If you want to try this kind of practice for yourself, I put together a free 3-day audio series that will help you start feeling more like yourself again.

The link is in my bio

tiktok.author: blakemycoskiephoto
tiktok.body:
Six months ago I started using an AI therapy app called Sonia in between my sessions with my therapist. I was a little skeptical at first. But I have found it incredibly useful, especially at 5am when anxiety wakes me up and calling my therapist is not exactly an option. So I asked Paul Conti what he thought. Paul is a world-renowned psychiatrist trained at Stanford and Harvard and someone who does not sugarcoat anything. And his answer was one of the most grounded things I have heard anyone say about AI in the mental health space. It is a tool. A powerful one. But the moment you start treating it like another human being, or worse, like something that is going to tell you what to do and guide your life, that is where it goes wrong. What he said next is what stuck with me. The reason it works for me is because I have already done the hard work of understanding myself through real therapy with a real person. The AI can help me access that understanding in the moments between sessions. But it cannot replace the process that built the understanding in the first place. Only people can do that for other people. Use every tool available to you. Just know what each one is actually for. The episode is live now. Click the link in the bio to listen.
